cs.LG / 1 / 2611.02955
Generative diffusion in long-range correlated landscapes: Speciation cascade and the foam structure of the score
长程关联景观中的生成扩散：物种形成级联与得分的泡沫结构
Jerome Garnier-Brun, Giulio Biroli, Marc Mézard, Jean-Philippe Bouchaud
cond-mat.dis-nn · cond-mat.stat-mech · cs.LG
diffusion
扩散模型相关
Abstract
While state of the art for image and video generation, the fundamental reasons for the effectiveness of generative diffusion remain unclear. In particular, the observed advantage of following an entire reverse process with respect to single-shot or autoregressive methods, and for what type of data it may hold, is not well understood. In this work, we aim to better understand the role of the reverse process by considering a complex yet analytically tractable data model, the Gibbs measure of a high-dimensional Gaussian random potential with long-range correlations. Focusing on the exact score, we show that the speciation threshold, in which a trajectory commits to one class of the data, becomes a speciation window, in which the reverse process progressively resolves the Parisi tree of pure states of the full replica-symmetry breaking measure, committing to ever finer branches down to a single pure state. Importantly, these commitments take place at noise levels where the noisy sample distinguishes the pure states only through an energy of order one, beyond the reach of standard replica saddle points. Constructing a Larkin argument suited to such $O(1)$ energy gaps, we describe the score as a foam, with slab-like cells separated by shock-like boundaries. In the variance-exploding process we consider, this window is followed by a shrinkage of the samples towards the data support, and finally by reconstruction within the selected pure state. The denoising error of the exact score follows these stages, dropping during the speciation window with a profile set by the Parisi function alone, and then within the selected state. We believe that the generative foam we describe, and in particular the boundaries between cells, could play an important role in determining where the errors of trained diffusion models redistribute the mass of the generated samples when the data are long-range correlated.
Chinese Translation
尽管在图像和视频生成方面达到了最先进水平，生成扩散有效性的根本原因仍然不清楚。特别是，相对于单步或自回归方法，遵循整个逆向过程所观察到的优势，以及它可能适用于何种类型的数据，尚未被很好地理解。在这项工作中，我们旨在通过考虑一个复杂但可解析处理的数据模型，即具有长程关联的高维高斯随机势的吉布斯测度，来更好地理解逆向过程的作用。聚焦于精确得分，我们表明，轨迹锁定到数据的一类中的物种形成阈值变成了一个物种形成窗口，在该窗口中，逆向过程逐步解析完全复本对称破缺测度的纯态的 Parisi 树，锁定到越来越精细的分支，直至单个纯态。重要的是，这些锁定发生在这样的噪声水平：噪声样本仅通过量级为一的能量区分纯态，这超出了标准复本鞍点的范围。构建适合于这种 $O(1)$ 能量间隙的 Larkin 论证，我们将得分描述为一种泡沫，其板状单元由激波状边界分隔。在我们考虑的方差爆炸过程中，这个窗口之后是样本向数据支撑集的收缩，最后是在所选纯态内的重建。精确得分的去噪误差遵循这些阶段，在物种形成窗口期间以仅由 Parisi 函数设定的剖面下降，然后在所选状态内下降。我们相信，我们所描述的生成泡沫，特别是单元之间的边界，可能在确定当数据具有长程关联时，训练扩散模型的误差将生成样本的质量重新分配到何处方面发挥重要作用。

cs.AI / 2 / 2611.02253
Can LLMs Reliably Evaluate Themselves? A Probabilistic VC Framework
大语言模型能可靠地评估自身吗？一个概率VC框架
Jae Oh Woo, Mengdie Flora Wang, Rahul Ghosh, Baishali Chaudhury, Mun Young Kim
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
As large language models (LLMs) find increasing use in critical applications, evaluating their ability to assess their own outputs has become crucial. We present a theoretical and empirical framework that examines whether LLMs can differentiate between correct and incorrect solutions while maintaining properly calibrated confidence. Building on classical Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) theory, we adapt it to probabilistic predictors through two complexity metrics: Probabilistic VC (PVC), which measures a model's ability to confidently classify across problem types, and Calibration-aware PVC (C-PVC), which additionally demands alignment between confidence scores and actual success rates. Unlike Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Actual Error (AE), these measures give an integrated assessment of self-evaluation expressiveness and calibration, with sample complexity bounds and generalization guarantees comparable to classical VC theory. We test eleven 7-8B models on 360 original mathematical reasoning problems, TruthfulQA, and CommonsenseQA. Each model chooses between two of its own generated solutions and reports its confidence, with ground truth determined by an ensemble of larger models. The results show a systematic inverse relationship: models with greater self-evaluation expressiveness have weaker calibration. s1.1-7B and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct achieve the highest PVC-VUS scores, while JiuZhang3.0-7B is best calibrated, with the lowest ECE and the smallest PVC-VUS gap. The trade-off persists across architectures, training paradigms, and domains, pointing to a fundamental challenge in developing self-reflective LLMs, and our framework offers practical tools for diagnosing it.
Chinese Translation
随着大语言模型（LLMs）在关键应用中的使用日益增多，评估其评估自身输出的能力已变得至关重要。我们提出了一个理论与实证框架，用以检验LLMs能否在保持恰当校准的置信度的同时，区分正确与错误的解决方案。基于经典的Vapnik-Chervonenkis（VC）理论，我们通过两个复杂度度量将其适配到概率预测器：概率VC（PVC），它衡量模型跨问题类型进行有置信度分类的能力；以及校准感知PVC（C-PVC），它额外要求置信度分数与实际成功率之间保持一致。与期望校准误差（ECE）和实际误差（AE）不同，这些度量对自我评估的表达能力和校准给出综合评估，并具有与经典VC理论相当的样本复杂度界和泛化保证。我们在360个原始数学推理问题、TruthfulQA和CommonsenseQA上测试了十一个7-8B模型。每个模型在其自身生成的两个解之间进行选择并报告其置信度，而真值由更大模型的集成确定。结果显示出一种系统性的反向关系：自我评估表达能力更强的模型，其校准更弱。s1.1-7B和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct取得最高的PVC-VUS分数，而JiuZhang3.0-7B校准最佳，具有最低的ECE和最小的PVC-VUS差距。这种权衡在不同架构、训练范式和领域中都持续存在，指向开发自我反思型LLMs中的一个根本性挑战，而我们的框架为诊断这一问题提供了实用工具。

cs.AI / 3 / 2611.02257
The 3-Tier Integrated Technology Risk Model for Occupational Safety and Health
职业安全与健康的三层集成技术风险模型
Ramiro Pesina, Ashish Madkaikar
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
This paper presents the 3-Tier Integrated Technology Risk Model, a progressive framework for Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) management that integrates Job Safety Analysis (JSA), dynamic risk assessment using leading and lagging indicators, and predictive analytics powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). The model provides organizations with a structured pathway to evolve from static, reactive safety practices to a sophisticated, predictive safety paradigm. Each tier builds upon the previous one, creating a comprehensive, data-driven approach that enables just-in-time training and preemptive risk mitigation.
Chinese Translation
本文提出了三层集成技术风险模型，这是一个用于职业安全与健康（OSH）管理的渐进式框架，它整合了工作安全分析（JSA）、利用领先指标与滞后指标开展的动态风险评估，以及由大语言模型（LLMs）驱动的预测分析。该模型为组织提供了一条结构化的路径，使其从静态的、被动反应式的安全实践，演进为精细化的预测型安全范式。每一层都建立在前一层的基础之上，形成一种全面的、数据驱动的方法，从而实现即时培训和先发制人的风险缓解。

cs.AI / 4 / 2611.02258
Beyond Binary Detection: Type-Aware Hallucination Analysis and Hierarchical Detection in Financial Question Answering
超越二值检测：金融问答中的类型感知幻觉分析与层次化检测
Xiongyu Chen, Sizhen Zhu, Zhuoer Wang
cs.AI · q-fin.CP
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models are increasingly used to answer questions over financial filings, where an unfaithful answer can mislead investment, compliance, or client decisions. Hallucination detectors are a common safeguard, but they are usually evaluated with a single binary score that reveals neither which kinds of errors analysesed nor why. This paper studies hallucination detection on PHANTOM, a long-context benchmark built from SEC filings, at the level of hallucination type. We first analyze 15,443 paired hallucinated and faithful answers without any detector and find that hallucinated answers are more than twice as long as faithful ones, and that lexical grounding separates the two classes only because faithful answers are bimodal. We then generate hallucinations in nine financially motivated categories, confirm each with a separate verification pass, and diagnose an LLM-based detector on 4,086 usable examples. Generation success varies from 66.3% to 100% across categories. The detector reaches 80.2% binary accuracy but only 44.7% subtype accuracy, never assigns two of the nine categories, and misses between 5.3% and 46.8% of hallucinations depending on category; these misses are unrelated to input length but rise with how far an answer departs from the correct one. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose a two-stage hierarchical detector that first decides whether an answer is hallucinated and then assigns a subtype, raising binary accuracy to 95.6% and subtype accuracy to 56.1%. The results show that type-level evaluation exposes detector weaknesses that aggregate metrics conceal.
Chinese Translation
大型语言模型越来越多地被用于回答关于财务申报文件的问题，而不忠实的答案可能误导投资、合规或客户决策。幻觉检测器是一种常见防护措施，但它们通常仅用单一的二值分数进行评估，该分数既不揭示出现了哪些类型的错误，也不揭示其原因。本文在幻觉类型层面研究 PHANTOM 上的幻觉检测，PHANTOM 是一个基于 SEC 申报文件构建的长上下文基准。我们首先在没有任何检测器的情况下分析 15,443 个配对的幻觉答案和忠实答案，发现幻觉答案的长度是忠实答案的两倍以上，并且词汇接地之所以能区分这两类，仅仅是因为忠实答案呈双峰分布。随后，我们在九个具有财务动机的类别中生成幻觉，用单独的验证流程确认每个幻觉，并在 4,086 个可用样例上诊断一个基于 LLM 的检测器。生成成功率在不同类别之间从 66.3% 到 100% 不等。该检测器达到 80.2% 的二值准确率，但子类型准确率仅为 44.7%，从未分配九个类别中的两个类别，并且根据类别不同漏检 5.3% 到 46.8% 的幻觉；这些漏检与输入长度无关，但随着答案偏离正确答案的程度增加而上升。在此诊断的指导下，我们提出一种两阶段层次化检测器，它首先判断一个答案是否为幻觉，然后分配一个子类型，将二值准确率提高到 95.6%，并将子类型准确率提高到 56.1%。结果表明，类型级评估揭示了聚合指标所掩盖的检测器弱点。

cs.AI / 5 / 2611.02286
Toward Agentic AI-Ready Workflows in Built Environment Organizations: Knowledge Structures and Interoperability Challenges
迈向建筑环境组织中智能体式人工智能就绪的工作流：知识结构与互操作性挑战
Ahmet Bahaddin Ersoz, Justin McHenry, Yevgeniya Kovalchuk, Edward Barrett, Mandana Sarey Khanie
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
The rise of agentic artificial intelligence (AI) in the built environment is shifting attention from isolated AI tools toward autonomous systems that reason, plan, and act across project and organizational workflows. The effectiveness of such systems depends not only on large language model capabilities, but also on the readiness of heterogeneous data environments across the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) sector. These environments combine structured sources, such as CAD and BIM models, schedules, cost databases, and asset registers, with unstructured ones, including technical reports, design narratives, planning and policy documents, contracts, meeting minutes, and risk registers. This paper reviews how built environment data can be organized to support agentic AI-ready workflows, focusing on knowledge structures, interoperability, and access and integration mechanisms such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Drawing on existing literature, it examines approaches proposed to organize structured and unstructured data and considers how such data can be contextualized and made accessible to AI agents in a reliable manner. The paper synthesizes current perspectives, highlights challenges around fragmentation and interoperability, and identifies open questions for future research on AI-compatible information management in the built environment.
Chinese Translation
智能体式人工智能（AI）在建筑环境中的兴起，正将关注点从孤立的AI工具转向能够在项目和组织工作流中进行推理、规划和行动的自主系统。此类系统的有效性不仅取决于大语言模型的能力，还取决于建筑、工程和施工（AEC）行业中异构数据环境的就绪程度。这些环境将结构化来源（如CAD和BIM模型、进度计划、成本数据库和资产登记册）与非结构化来源（包括技术报告、设计说明、规划与政策文件、合同、会议纪要和风险登记册）结合在一起。本文回顾了如何组织建筑环境数据以支持智能体式AI就绪的工作流，重点关注知识结构、互操作性以及检索增强生成（RAG）和模型上下文协议（MCP）等访问与集成机制。基于现有文献，本文考察了为组织结构化和非结构化数据而提出的方法，并探讨了如何以可靠的方式对此类数据进行情境化并使其可供AI智能体访问。本文综合了当前观点，突出了围绕碎片化和互操作性的挑战，并指出了未来研究建筑环境中AI兼容信息管理的开放问题。

cs.AI / 6 / 2611.02455
RLiD: Reinforcement Learning in the Decision Plane for Language Agents and LLMs
RLiD：面向语言智能体与大语言模型的决策平面强化学习
Ziyi Chen, Yan Zhang, Jianhui Wei, Jianing Yin, Daoan Zhang
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Reinforcement learning (RL) has improved the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) across a wide range of tasks. However, token-level RL assigns an action's advantage to the entire generated response, including tokens specifying the parsed action, reasoning chains, and malformed content. Although the environment executes only the parsed action, variation in how the action is expressed in natural language can introduce additional variance into policy-gradient estimates. We propose RLiD (Reinforcement Learning in the Decision plane), a framework that directly optimizes the probabilities of executable action options. RLiD compiles observations, an optional compact memory, and a labeled action menu into the model input, and uses a large decision model (LDM) to select an action in a single forward pass. By eliminating autoregressive token generation and bypassing action parsing, RLiD avoids invalid action outputs and improves RL rollout efficiency. Our analysis shows that, within a fixed text policy, marginalizing over alternative realizations of the same action removes a zero-mean gradient component without changing the expected update. We further distill trained LDM policies into generative LLMs through supervision on their action trajectories. Experiments on ARC, Countdown, and Sokoban demonstrate improved performance or lower computational cost across several settings. On ALFWorld, the complete training and distillation pipeline reaches 99.3% success in 12.7 H100 GPU-hours, compared with 86.6% in 17.3 GPU-hours for token-level RL of the same LLM. With compiled memory, our strongest Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM and distilled generative LLM achieve 100% success on all 134 unseen and 140 seen ALFWorld evaluation games.
Chinese Translation
强化学习（RL）已在广泛任务中提升了大语言模型（LLM）的能力。然而，token 级 RL 会将动作的优势归因于整个生成的回复，包括指定解析动作的 token、推理链以及格式错误的内容。尽管环境只执行解析出的动作，但动作在自然语言中表达方式的变化可能会给策略梯度估计引入额外的方差。我们提出 RLiD（Reinforcement Learning in the Decision plane，决策平面强化学习），这是一个直接优化可执行动作选项概率的框架。RLiD 将观测、可选的紧凑记忆以及带标签的动作菜单编译为模型输入，并使用大型决策模型（LDM）在单次前向传播中选择动作。通过消除自回归 token 生成并绕过动作解析，RLiD 避免了无效动作输出并提高了 RL rollout 效率。我们的分析表明，在固定文本策略下，对同一动作的替代实现进行边缘化会去除一个零均值梯度分量，而不改变期望更新。我们进一步通过对动作轨迹的监督，将训练后的 LDM 策略蒸馏到生成式 LLM 中。在 ARC、Countdown 和 Sokoban 上的实验表明，在多种设置下性能得到提升或计算成本降低。在 ALFWorld 上，完整的训练与蒸馏流程在 12.7 个 H100 GPU 小时内达到 99.3% 的成功率，而同一 LLM 的 token 级 RL 在 17.3 个 GPU 小时内为 86.6%。借助编译记忆，我们最强的 Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM 以及蒸馏后的生成式 LLM 在全部 134 个未见过的和 140 个见过的 ALFWorld 评估游戏中均达到 100% 的成功率。

cs.AI / 7 / 2611.02503
Towards Multi-Value Alignment via Value Localization in LLMs
面向LLMs中价值定位的多价值对齐
Xueqi Ma, Yanbei Jiang, Xingjun Ma, James Bailey, Sarah M. Erfani
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Aligning large language models (LLMs) with multiple, potentially conflicting human values remains challenging, as existing multi-objective alignment methods often require costly fine-tuning and provide limited insight into the internal mechanisms underlying value-related behaviors. In this work, we investigate multi-value alignment from a mechanistic interpretability perspective by identifying value-sensitive attention heads (value heads) in LLMs. Using a probing-based value localization framework, we discover sparse sets of attention heads associated with diverse dimensions, spanning both human values (e.g., harmlessness, honesty) and stylistic preferences (e.g., coherence, complexity). Analyses across multiple LLM families reveal functional specialization and structured interactions among value heads, including conflicts between certain values. Targeted head ablations further induce substantial, value-specific behavioral changes, providing causal evidence of their functional importance. Building on these findings, we propose an inference-time activation steering strategy that enables controllable alignment with individual values or combinations of values without updating the underlying model parameters, supported by theoretical analysis. Experiments across multiple value alignment benchmarks demonstrate effective single- and multi-value control while largely preserving non-target model performance. Our findings connect mechanistic interpretability with flexible multi-value alignment, offering a foundation for more interpretable and pluralistic LLM behavior. The code is available at https://github.com/sihuo-design/ValueHeads.
Chinese Translation
使大语言模型（LLMs）与多种可能相互冲突的人类价值对齐仍然具有挑战性，因为现有的多目标对齐方法往往需要昂贵的微调，并且对价值相关行为背后的内部机制所提供的洞见有限。在本工作中，我们从机制可解释性的视角研究多价值对齐，通过识别LLMs中对价值敏感的注意力头（价值头）。使用基于探针的价值定位框架，我们发现了与多样维度相关的稀疏注意力头集合，这些维度涵盖人类价值（例如，无害性、诚实性）和风格偏好（例如，连贯性、复杂性）。跨多个LLM系列的分析揭示了价值头之间的功能专门化和结构化交互，包括某些价值之间的冲突。定向头消融进一步诱发了实质性的、价值特定的行为变化，为其功能重要性提供了因果证据。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种推理时激活引导策略，该策略能够在无需更新底层模型参数的情况下实现与单个价值或价值组合的可控对齐，并得到了理论分析的支持。跨多个价值对齐基准的实验表明，该方法能够有效进行单价值和多价值控制，同时在很大程度上保持非目标模型的性能。我们的发现将机制可解释性与灵活的多价值对齐联系起来，为更具可解释性和多元化的LLM行为提供了基础。代码可在 https://github.com/sihuo-design/ValueHeads 获取。

cs.AI / 8 / 2611.02516
Cumulative and Audited Guardrail Tool Evolution for LLM Agent Safety
面向 LLM 智能体安全的累积式与经审计的护栏工具演化
Xiao Yang, Aishan Liu, Siyuan Liang, Zonghao Ying, Le Wang, Jiakai Wang, Xianglong Liu, Dacheng Tao
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in open-world environments where safety risks cannot be fully predefined. However, most existing guardrail mechanisms remain static, relying on fixed rules, prompts, or classifiers that generalize poorly to emerging risks. Here we present EVOLVE, a tool-level self-evolving defense framework that formulates agent security as a process of cumulative security evolution. Inspired by how human societies transform experiences into transferable protective knowledge, EVOLVE externalizes security knowledge into executable guardrail tools that are continuously inherited, independently audited, and iteratively refined through lifelong interaction. Across multiple benchmarks, backbone models, and embodied environments, EVOLVE consistently outperforms existing defenses across diverse risk scenarios with +22\% average F1 score. We further validate the framework in real-world robotic and autonomous agent systems. Our results suggest that scalable agent safety may require continuously evolving defense systems rather than static guardrails.
Chinese Translation
大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地在无法完全预先定义安全风险的开放世界环境中运行。然而，大多数现有的护栏机制仍然是静态的，依赖于固定的规则、提示或分类器，对新兴风险的泛化能力较差。在此，我们提出 EVOLVE，一个工具级的自演化防御框架，它将智能体安全表述为一个累积式安全演化的过程。受人类社会如何将经验转化为可迁移的保护性知识的启发，EVOLVE 将安全知识外化为可执行的护栏工具，这些工具通过终身交互被持续继承、独立审计并迭代改进。在多个基准、骨干模型和具身环境中，EVOLVE 在多样化风险场景下始终优于现有防御方法，平均 F1 分数提升 +22\%。我们进一步在真实世界的机器人和自主智能体系统中验证了该框架。我们的结果表明，可扩展的智能体安全可能需要持续演化的防御系统，而不是静态护栏。

FORGE: Fault-Oriented Rework Code Generation for Executable Interlocking Assembly
FORGE：面向故障的可执行互锁装配返工代码生成
Fuqiang Wang, Jiahao Fu, Ren Hefeng, Yining Qian, Chuanting Zhang, Cheng Tan, Yuwen Liu, Jingxuan Wei
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models have demonstrated strong capabilities in structured reasoning and code generation, yet identifying an assembly fault does not guarantee the ability to generate executable rework programs. In interlocking assemblies, a locally plausible repair program may violate blocking dependencies, omit required recovery operations, or terminate in an incorrect configuration. We identify this challenge as fault-conditioned executable rework generation, where models must jointly reason about structural failures and generate programs that restore constrained assembly states. To benchmark this capability, we introduce FORGE-Bench, containing 4,000 tasks across 26 interlocking assemblies with five assemblies held out for evaluating generalization to unseen structures. We further propose FORGE (Fault-Oriented Rework Code Generation for Executable Interlocking Assembly), a structured state-to-program framework that decomposes rework generation into Rework Structuring and Action Grounding. Rework Structuring captures fault-induced recovery dependencies, while Action Grounding maps these dependencies into state-conditioned executable actions. Experiments show that locally reasonable repair code is insufficient for reliable assembly recovery, and that connecting structural recovery reasoning with executable action realization is essential for verified target restoration.
Chinese Translation
大语言模型已在结构化推理和代码生成方面展现出强大能力，但识别出装配故障并不保证能够生成可执行的返工程序。在互锁装配中，一个局部看似合理的修复程序可能违反阻塞依赖关系、遗漏所需的恢复操作，或终止于不正确的配置。我们将这一挑战定义为故障条件下的可执行返工生成，其中模型必须联合推理结构故障，并生成能够恢复受约束装配状态的程序。为了对该能力进行基准测试，我们引入 FORGE-Bench，它包含跨 26 个互锁装配的 4,000 个任务，并留出五个装配用于评估对未见结构的泛化能力。我们进一步提出 FORGE（Fault-Oriented Rework Code Generation for Executable Interlocking Assembly，面向故障的可执行互锁装配返工代码生成），这是一个结构化的状态到程序框架，将返工生成分解为返工结构化和动作落地。返工结构化捕获故障引发的恢复依赖关系，而动作落地将这些依赖关系映射为状态条件下的可执行动作。实验表明，局部合理的修复代码不足以实现可靠的装配恢复，并且将结构恢复推理与可执行动作实现相连接对于经过验证的目标恢复至关重要。

Probing Local Conditional Fit for Diffusion Model Membership Inference
探究用于扩散模型成员推断的局部条件拟合
ByungHee Cha, Naoki Murata, Yuhta Takida, Jong Chul Ye, Yuki Mitsufuji
cs.AI · cs.CV · cs.LG
diffusion
扩散模型相关
Abstract
Membership inference determines whether a candidate example was used to train a text-to-image diffusion model and is an important tool for auditing training-data use. We identify a directional membership signal in \emph{conditional prediction shifts}, the changes in predicted noise under alternative text conditions at a fixed noisy input: whether movement toward the alternative prediction initially lowers or raises the denoising loss from its value under the original caption. Members exhibit less room for such local improvement. To quantify this response, we propose \emph{LoFIT} (Local Conditional Fit), which measures the initial response of the denoising loss along normalized prediction shifts and aggregates it across multiple text conditions and diffusion states. LoFIT requires no target-model gradients and can be computed using only forward queries to the denoiser. Evaluations on four datasets show improved membership discrimination across fine-tuned and pretrained models. LoFIT distinguishes members early in fine-tuning, while the naive denoising-loss baseline remains near chance. Controlled comparisons show that the membership signal is concentrated in the first-order response, with little discrimination from prediction-shift magnitude alone.

成员推断判定一个候选样本是否曾被用于训练文本到图像扩散模型，并且是审计训练数据使用情况的重要工具。我们在\emph{条件预测偏移}中发现了一种方向性成员信号，即在固定噪声输入下，替代文本条件所引起的预测噪声变化：朝着替代预测移动时，去噪损失相对于原始文本描述下的取值最初是下降还是上升。成员样本表现出较小的此类局部改进空间。为了量化这一响应，我们提出\emph{LoFIT}（Local Conditional Fit，局部条件拟合），它测量去噪损失沿归一化预测偏移的初始响应，并在多个文本条件和扩散状态上对其进行聚合。LoFIT 不需要目标模型的梯度，并且可以仅通过对去噪器的前向查询来计算。在四个数据集上的评估表明，在微调模型和预训练模型上均获得了更好的成员判别能力。LoFIT 在微调早期就能区分成员，而朴素去噪损失基线仍接近随机水平。受控比较表明，成员信号集中在一阶响应中，而仅凭预测偏移幅度几乎无法获得判别能力。

BasisKV: Value Latents for Communication and Key Routing
BasisKV：用于通信与键路由的值潜在表示
Lixun Zhang, Zishan Shao, Kangning Cui, Yu Liang, Fan Yang, Yiran Chen
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly constrained by the cost of maintaining an ever-growing KV-cache. Low-rank K/V projections provide a promising way to compress the KV-cache with minimal quality loss, but prior work has largely optimized KV-cache compression in isolation, leaving distributed inference, especially with tensor parallelism where attention computation is partitioned across multiple GPUs, largely underexplored. We make two observations: (i) tensor-parallel communication is an important cost when deploying low-rank KV-cache compression in distributed inference; and (ii) Value compression can be associated with the output projection, allowing the same low-rank Value representation to reduce both Value-cache width and tensor-parallel communication. Based on these observations, we propose BasisKV, a low-rank KV-cache compression method for communication-intensive, long-context LLM inference. BasisKV jointly optimizes the low-rank factors across per-GPU attention partitions against the complete attention output, rather than fitting each partition in isolation. The compressed Value cache is further reused to help identify which Key pages should be accessed: it predicts part of the Key information needed for routing, while a Key-specific residual stores what cannot be recovered from Value. The original Keys are then retrieved only for the selected pages to compute exact QK scores. Across multiple LLM families and system settings, BasisKV achieves a better quality--efficiency tradeoff than existing low-rank baselines, reaching up to 1.42x end-to-end speedup under 8-GPU tensor-parallel inference. Our code is available at https://github.com/alexz949/BasisKV
Chinese Translation
长上下文大语言模型（LLM）推理日益受到维护不断增长的 KV 缓存成本的制约。低秩 K/V 投影提供了一种有前景的方法，可以在质量损失最小的情况下压缩 KV 缓存，但先前的工作大多孤立地优化 KV 缓存压缩，使得分布式推理——尤其是注意力计算跨多个 GPU 划分的张量并行——在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。我们做出两点观察：(i) 在分布式推理中部署低秩 KV 缓存压缩时，张量并行通信是一项重要成本；(ii) 值压缩可以与输出投影相关联，从而使相同的低秩值表示既能降低值缓存宽度，又能减少张量并行通信。基于这些观察，我们提出 BasisKV，一种面向通信密集型长上下文 LLM 推理的低秩 KV 缓存压缩方法。BasisKV 针对完整注意力输出联合优化各 GPU 注意力分区上的低秩因子，而不是孤立地拟合每个分区。压缩后的值缓存进一步被复用于帮助识别应访问哪些键页：它预测路由所需的部分键信息，而键特定残差存储无法从值中恢复的内容。然后仅针对所选页面检索原始键，以计算精确的 QK 分数。在多个 LLM 系列和系统设置中，BasisKV 实现了比现有低秩基线更好的质量—效率权衡，在 8-GPU 张量并行推理下达到最高 1.42x 的端到端加速。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/alexz949/BasisKV 获取。

Variable names provide priors: semantic grounding enables data-efficient numerical prediction by large language models
变量名提供先验：语义接地使大语言模型能够实现数据高效的数值预测
Xin-Rui Ma, Shi-Zhi Chen, Hai-Yan Jiang, De-Cheng Feng, Michael Beer
cs.AI · cs.CL · cs.LG
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse tasks, from question answering to code generation. Recent studies have found that LLMs can perform numerical prediction on tabular datasets via in-context learning. However, it remains unclear under what conditions and how LLMs use variable names and in-context examples for numerical prediction. Here we show that semantic grounding, the match between variable names and the values they describe, allows five LLMs without task-specific training to match or outperform seven supervised machine learning (ML) models across 20 datasets from nine scientific domains, particularly when examples are scarce. Reasoning traces indicate that variable names allow LLMs to draw on domain-specific knowledge acquired during pretraining. Using controlled tasks based on physical formulas, we further show that LLMs integrate domain-specific knowledge with in-context examples in a way consistent with Bayesian updating. Specifically, when the relationship between the inputs and the target cannot be inferred from the examples alone, LLMs rely on domain-specific knowledge as the prior. Conversely, as contradicting examples accumulate, LLM predictions shift progressively towards these examples, which act as the likelihood. Our work reveals how LLMs use domain-specific knowledge in numerical prediction and positions them as data-efficient predictors for data-scarce scientific domains.

大语言模型（LLMs）在从问答到代码生成等多种任务中都取得了强劲的表现。近期研究发现，LLMs 能够通过上下文学习在表格数据集上进行数值预测。然而，LLMs 在何种条件下以及如何利用变量名和上下文示例进行数值预测，目前仍不清楚。在此，我们表明，语义接地，即变量名与其所描述的取值之间的匹配，使得五个未经任务特定训练的 LLMs 能够在来自九个科学领域的 20 个数据集上达到或超越七个监督机器学习（ML）模型的水平，尤其是在示例稀缺时。推理轨迹表明，变量名使 LLMs 能够利用在预训练期间获得的领域特定知识。使用基于物理公式的受控任务，我们进一步表明，LLMs 以一种与贝叶斯更新相一致的方式将领域特定知识与上下文示例相结合。具体而言，当输入与目标之间的关系无法仅从示例中推断出来时，LLMs 将领域特定知识作为先验。相反，随着相互矛盾的示例不断积累，LLM 的预测逐渐向这些示例偏移，这些示例充当似然。我们的工作揭示了 LLMs 在数值预测中如何使用领域特定知识，并将其定位为面向数据稀缺科学领域的数据高效预测器。

SearchInject: Retrieval Exposure Control for Indirect Prompt Injection in Language-Model Search
SearchInject：语言模型搜索中间接提示注入的检索暴露控制
Kainan Zhou, Gangzhen Qian, Janet Sung, Zhi Jing, Rong Bao, Qianru Lao
cs.AI · cs.CY · cs.IR · cs.LG
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
An indirect prompt injection can affect a search-augmented large language model only after its carrier page reaches model context. SearchInject controls this admission decision with a joint score combining retrieval relevance, search-abuse cues, instruction likelihood, and two relevance interactions. A quarantine threshold is selected under an empirical 0.5% clean-candidate false-quarantine constraint on a calibration split. Evaluation uses 300 held-out SciFact queries and held-out payload categories within four construction families already represented during development. Across 1,200 query-family outcomes per retriever, top-10 target exposure falls from 0.9408 to 0.1583 for BM25, from 0.9158 to 0.1508 for a normalized hybrid, and from 0.8450 to 0.1375 for latent semantic analysis. These are relative reductions of 83.2-83.7%; the largest absolute change in clean normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank 10 is 0.0018. The frozen threshold yields clean test false-quarantine rates of 0.59-0.65%, above the empirical calibration constraint. A query-level analytical reanalysis accounts for the repeated construction outcomes under an independent-query assumption. A separate 104-case generation follow-up records context removal but no confirmed undefended hijacks under a post hoc endpoint, so it cannot estimate a reduction in attack success. The evidence supports retrieval exposure control within the evaluated construction families; the benefit of the interaction terms at matched clean cost remains unresolved.

UPSHIFT: User Preference Steering from Human-AI Interaction Feedback Traces
UPSHIFT：从人机交互反馈轨迹中进行用户偏好引导
Jingping Wang, Zhanhao Li, Shao Zhang, Shuyue Hu
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Personalizing large language model assistants requires adapting their responses to individual users, including the selection of content, reasoning approach, level of detail, and form of presentation. Such preferences are often latent, becoming visible only when users respond to an initial answer and request revisions. We investigate whether these feedback trajectories can be converted into a reusable personalization signal without explicit preference profiles or labels, prompt-time access to interaction histories, or model parameter updates. We introduce UPSHIFT (User Preference Steering from Human-AI Interaction Feedback Traces), a training-free method that compares the hidden representations of initial and feedback-conditioned responses within each session, averages the resulting trajectory displacements across a user's sessions, and injects the aggregated preference direction when answering a new query. The method is motivated by the implicit-preference hypothesis: although an individual conversational transition may reflect topic progression or task-specific correction, changes that recur across sessions retain a component that captures how the user wants responses to be adjusted. We validate the preference-representation capability of UPSHIFT on PrefEval. In evaluations with 40 simulated users, every tested configuration improves preference alignment over the unsteered baseline on held-out topics for both Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B; the best configuration increases macro-averaged Elo from 1364.0 to 1605.2 and from 1341.9 to 1591.8, respectively. Matched-user and positive-versus-negative controls further demonstrate that these gains arise from the user-specific preference direction and its learned orientation. These results show that interaction histories can provide compact, reusable supervision for lightweight personalization.

个性化大型语言模型助手需要使其响应适配个体用户，包括内容的选择、推理方法、细节程度和呈现形式。这类偏好往往是潜在的，只有当用户对初始答案作出回应并提出修改请求时才变得可见。我们研究是否可以将这些反馈轨迹转化为可复用的个性化信号，而无需显式的偏好画像或标签、无需在提示时访问交互历史，也无需更新模型参数。我们提出 UPSHIFT（User Preference Steering from Human-AI Interaction Feedback Traces，从人机交互反馈轨迹中进行用户偏好引导），这是一种免训练方法，它比较每个会话内初始响应与反馈条件下响应的隐藏表示，对用户各会话中得到的轨迹位移取平均，并在回答新查询时注入聚合后的偏好方向。该方法受隐式偏好假设启发：尽管单次对话转变可能反映话题推进或任务特定的纠正，但在多个会话中反复出现的变化保留了一个成分，该成分捕捉了用户希望如何调整响应。我们在 PrefEval 上验证了 UPSHIFT 的偏好表示能力。在 40 个模拟用户的评估中，对于 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B，每种测试配置在留出主题上都比未引导基线改善了偏好对齐；最佳配置分别将宏平均 Elo 从 1364.0 提高到 1605.2，从 1341.9 提高到 1591.8。匹配用户对照和正负对照进一步表明，这些增益来自用户特定的偏好方向及其学习到的取向。这些结果表明，交互历史可以为轻量级个性化提供紧凑、可复用的监督。

cs.AI / 15 / 2611.02711
Human-Supervised Artificial Intelligence Researchers in Electric Power Systems: Knowledge, Physics, Simulation, and Governance for Large Language Models
电力系统中人类监督的人工智能研究者：面向大语言模型的知识、物理、仿真与治理
Xiangrui Meng, Jingcheng Liu, Ke Wang, Miaopeng Yu, Zhengping Lin
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Conclusions in power-system research require a clear evidential basis. Researchers need to understand the data sources, modelling assumptions, and solution procedures to assess the conditions under which a conclusion holds. Large language models (LLMs) can help researchers extract information from documents and translate research requests into code and tool calls, but their outputs still require physical validation. Focusing on human-supervised artificial intelligence (AI) researchers, this review examines power-system LLM applications and related scientific workflows, together with physics-grounded power AI studies, to discuss the conditions for using LLMs in scientific research. In the proposed knowledge-physics-simulation-governance framework, LLMs translate information and coordinate tasks, simulators and validation tools test models, and experts retain authority over critical assumptions, safety boundaries, and final conclusions. Research processes should preserve materials for review so that claims can be traced to their sources, computations can be reproduced, and failed attempts and approvals can be examined. On this basis, a staged development roadmap and requirements for research reporting are proposed. Evaluation should focus on research artifacts and their validation to assess whether LLMs can improve the efficiency of power-system research within clearly defined permissions.

Is your LLM an Agressive Narcissist with Depression? Analyzing Psychological Portraits of Large Language Models
你的LLM是一个患有抑郁症的攻击性自恋者吗？分析大型语言模型的心理画像
Polina Fedorinina, Anna Fattakhova, Nadezhda Romanova, Ekaterina Lezina, Irina Nikishina
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Nowadays, interaction with AI requires caution not only regarding the factual reliability of generated content but also regarding personality markers that models may implicitly transmit during dialogue that can subtly influence users' perception of information. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale experimental study in which 22 large language models complete 11 psychological inventories. Furthermore, we investigate correlations between human and model responses to track the adjustments made for the users who interact with them on a daily basis. The results show that LLMs exhibit coherent and relatively stable psychological patterns. Personality traits remain largely consistent, whereas emotional and symptomatic dimensions are more variable, with anxiety and neuroticism emerging as dominant tendencies. Model explanations further suggest that LLMs generate internally consistent and safety-oriented profiles while also reflecting correlations with the users they regularly interact with.

cs.AI / 17 / 2611.02807
Creating Hybrid Interactive Narrative Systems with LLM: From Formal Description to Evaluation
使用 LLM 创建混合交互式叙事系统：从形式化描述到评估
Jules Clerc, Domitile Lourdeaux, Mohamed Sallak, Marc Ravaine
cs.AI · cs.CL · cs.HC
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Interactive narratives let users shape a story while an Experience Manager (EM) keeps it coherent, balancing player freedom against authorial control. Large Language Models now enable a new generation of hybrid EMs, which combine run-time generation from free-text input with symbolic narrative control. However, their heterogeneity makes them hard to compare: A manager's behaviour is generally tied to the unique and specific scenario in which it operates, and much of its decision-making takes place outside of any explicit and verifiable structure. We address this with an LLM-based narrative platform whose managers are interchangeable modules operating over a shared symbolic world model of facts, operations, and goals. Because every applied operation carries explicit preconditions and effects, each session can be analysed as a plan through a common state-transition representation and evaluated, independently of how the manager works internally, with shared indicators of four properties: player agency, EM controllability, author intent, and robustness. We implement three contrasting managers, based respectively on open generation, Monte Carlo repair, and autonomous characters, and compare them through functional analysis on an interactive Little Red Riding Hood scenario. The results show that no manager dominates on every property, giving authors and EM designers a concrete basis to select a manager according to their priorities.

交互式叙事让用户塑造故事，同时由体验管理器（Experience Manager，EM）保持其连贯性，在玩家自由与作者控制之间取得平衡。大型语言模型如今催生了新一代混合式 EM，它们将基于自由文本输入的运行时生成与符号化叙事控制相结合。然而，它们的异质性使其难以比较：管理器的行为通常与其运行所处的独特而具体的场景绑定，并且其决策的很大一部分发生在任何显式且可验证的结构之外。我们通过一个基于 LLM 的叙事平台来解决这一问题，该平台中的管理器是可互换的模块，运行在由事实、操作和目标构成的共享符号世界模型之上。由于每个被应用的操作都带有显式的前置条件和效果，因此每次会话都可以通过一种通用的状态转移表示被分析为一个规划，并且可以独立于管理器内部的工作方式，用四项属性的共享指标进行评估：玩家能动性、EM 可控性、作者意图和鲁棒性。我们实现了三个形成对照的管理器，分别基于开放生成、蒙特卡洛修复和自主角色，并通过在一个交互式《小红帽》场景上的功能分析对它们进行比较。结果表明，没有任何一个管理器在每一项属性上都占优，这为作者和 EM 设计者根据其优先考虑来选择管理器提供了具体依据。

Predictive Safety Guardrails Do Not Always Make LLM Agents Safer
预测性安全护栏并不总是让LLM智能体更安全
Weixiang Zhao, Zhihao Liu, Guancheng Li, Yanyan Zhao, Bing Qin, Ting Liu
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language model agents increasingly take consequential actions in digital and physical environments, where safety risks may emerge only after multiple interaction steps. This has motivated world-model-driven predictive safety guardrails, which anticipate future consequences before execution. However, existing evaluations largely focus on end-to-end safety outcomes, leaving unclear whether safety gains arise from reliable prediction and faithful use of predicted risks. In this work, we systematically diagnose the prediction-to-action pipeline along three dimensions: how world-model predictions are integrated into decision making, whether the predictions themselves are reliable, and whether their content is faithfully used. Across seven policy models and two safety environments, we find that stronger prediction involvement does not yield monotonic safety gains and can reduce task completion while substantially increasing inference cost. We further find that world-model predictions remain insufficiently reliable, especially over longer horizons, where safety prediction degrades substantially relative to near-term forecasting. Finally, we find that safety gains can persist even under corrupted predictions, while locally verified predictions still leave subsequent safety violations, showing that predictive content is not faithfully incorporated into the decision process. Together, these findings expose a fundamental prediction-to-action gap in current predictive guardrails: producing more or seemingly accurate foresight is insufficient unless that foresight is both reliable and faithfully translated into safer decisions.

大语言模型智能体越来越多地在数字和物理环境中采取具有后果的行动，而在这些环境中，安全风险可能仅在多个交互步骤之后才会出现。这推动了由世界模型驱动的预测性安全护栏，这类护栏在执行之前预判未来后果。然而，现有评估主要关注端到端的安全结果，尚不清楚安全收益是否来自可靠的预测以及对预测风险的忠实使用。在这项工作中，我们从三个维度系统地诊断从预测到行动的流程：世界模型预测如何被整合到决策中、预测本身是否可靠，以及预测内容是否被忠实使用。在七个策略模型和两个安全环境中，我们发现更强的预测参与并不会带来单调的安全收益，并且可能降低任务完成率，同时显著增加推理成本。我们进一步发现，世界模型预测仍然不够可靠，尤其是在更长的时间跨度上，此时安全预测相对于近期预测会显著退化。最后，我们发现即使预测被破坏，安全收益仍可能持续存在，而经过局部验证的预测仍会留下后续的安全违规，这表明预测内容并未被忠实纳入决策过程。总之，这些发现揭示了当前预测性护栏中存在一个根本性的从预测到行动的鸿沟：产生更多或看似准确的预见是不够的，除非这种预见既可靠又被忠实地转化为更安全的决策。

SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
SpecOPD：用于推测解码的分支并行同策略蒸馏
Tianyu Liu, Jun Zhang, Wenjie Huang, Yuhao Shen, Tianqi Xu, Xinyue Hao, Hongyaoxing Gu, Xuyang Liu, Baolin Zhang, Yating Zhu, Shuang Ge, Jun Dai, Lei Chen, Yue Li, Mingchen Wan
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by reducing the sequential cost of token-by-token generation. Advanced SD methods reduce proposal cost with parallel drafters that predict entire blocks in one forward pass, but overall speedup still depends on acceptance length. On-policy distillation (OPD) can push well-trained drafters beyond acceptance-length plateaus, yet conventional pipelines collect supervision through sequential draft-and-verify rollouts. Our key insight is that on-policy supervision need not inherit these dependencies: a draft block can be supervised using only its reference prefix and draft-sampled history. We propose SpecOPD, a branch-parallel OPD framework that parallelizes draft sampling and target supervision across independent branches drawn from the evolving drafter policy at reference anchors. We pack these branches into proposal trees to share target-prefix computation, using tree masks for full attention, branch-consistent indexer groups for sparse attention, and indexed state replay for linear attention to preserve each branch's history. We train the drafter with an E2E-TV surrogate that directly targets acceptance length. Our study spans 8B full-attention (GQA), 27B full-linear (GQA--GDN), and 125B sparse-linear (QSA--GDN) targets, three parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark, and DFlash V2), and four task domains (dialogue, coding, mathematics, and agentic). SpecOPD achieves up to 41.45% higher mean acceptance length, $16.09\times$ supervised-token throughput over sequential-rollout OPD under native configurations, and up to $3.56\times$ generation speedup over autoregressive decoding.

BLPO: Beyond-Local Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

Xuanren Chen, Chongyang Tao, Wenpeng Hu, Yong Wang, Bo Deng, Xinlei Zheng, Shuai Ma
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Long-horizon tasks require large language model (LLM) agents to coordinate interdependent actions, a capability central to automating complex workflows. Stepwise group-based reinforcement learning provides finer credit than trajectory-level supervision, but reliable comparisons must account for differences in interaction history. Enforcing this consistency within the limited rollouts of each task can leave insufficient support for estimating action preferences. We propose Beyond-Local Policy Optimization (BLPO), which estimates task-progress advantages from experience shared across tasks and training updates. We summarize trajectory prefixes into task-progress states and abstract actions by their function, allowing corresponding decisions from different tasks to contribute to shared estimates. To control bias and noise from heterogeneous tasks, we accumulate context-relative returns in a global memory with balanced aggregation and reliability weighting. These global advantages complement local comparisons over normalized actions and trajectory-level credit without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with 1.5B and 7B policies show improved task success over the evaluated baselines under matched training budgets. Further analyses show faster learning and shorter trajectories with little computational overhead.

Towards a Trustworthy and Governable Internet of Agentics: An Architectural Perspective on Protocols, Systems, and Services
迈向可信且可治理的智能体互联网：协议、系统与服务的架构视角

cs.AI · cs.DC
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language model applications are increasingly being organized as tool-using and multi-agent workflows rather than as isolated chat interfaces. This perspective paper examines the architectural problem that follows from that shift: agents may reason, invoke tools, and delegate work, but dependable deployment still requires interoperability across frameworks, runtimes, data boundaries, and organizational control domains. We study this problem through the lens of the \emph{Internet of Agentics} (IoA), an emerging service-computing view in which heterogeneous agents are treated as governable service participants rather than only as stand-alone model endpoints. The paper organizes the landscape as a three-layer progression: from today's fragmented agent ecosystem, to interoperable agents, and ultimately to trustworthy and governable autonomy. First, it examines the protocol stack centered on the Agentic AI Foundation, including MCP for agent--tool interaction; A2A for agent--agent coordination; AGENTS.md and Skills-style procedural manifests; and discovery, transport, and trust mechanisms such as AGNTCY and SLIM. Second, it reviews the systems abstractions that make agents deployable as service components, including logical agent architectures, orchestration patterns, gateways, registries, runtime control loops, and hardware-aware inference infrastructure. Third, it situates these developments within services computing, arguing that agentic systems reinterpret classical concerns from SOA and microservices---discovery, composition, governance, pricing, and trust---at the level of cognitive capabilities rather than deterministic functions.

From Local Skills to Long-Horizon Web Tasks: Progressive Skill Exploration for LLM Web Agents

Xueyang Feng, Xiaohe Bo, Xu Chen, Quanyu Dai, Feng Wen
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models (LLMs) are driving autonomous agents toward real-world environments, with the Web emerging as one of the most representative interaction scenarios. However, training Web agents with naive exploration remains challenging: successful trajectories are rare, and the sparse terminal rewards make it difficult for agents to obtain useful feedback from failed trajectories. Inspired by skill acquisition theory, we propose Skill-Composed Progressive Exploration (SCOPE), a short-to-long learning framework for long-horizon Web agents that decomposes complex task exploration into a gradual expansion process from local skills to complete task-solving capability. Specifically, SCOPE iteratively explores around local skills: Skill Discovery extracts reusable local skills and failure experiences from historical rollouts; Skill Orchestration composes discovered skills into high-level skill chains; and Skill Expansion leverages failure experiences aligned with the current skill chain to guide the agent toward exploring new subskills. Through this process, SCOPE progressively constructs task-completing skill chains across rollouts and internalizes them into the policy parameters through agentic on-policy distillation. Extensive experiments on WebArena, WebVoyager, and WebShop show that SCOPE consistently improves exploration dynamics and achieves 3.9% to 18.6% relative gains over the strongest baselines in each setting.

Toward Knowledge-Centric AI: Discovering, Internalizing, and Using Explicit Knowledge Across Agents and Generations
迈向以知识为中心的人工智能：跨智能体与代际发现、内化并使用显式知识
Yisen Gao, Haoyu Huang, Zhongwei Xie, Yufei Li, Hong Ting Tsang, Boyi Zhang, Qiao Xiao, Tianshi Zheng, Jiaxin Bai, Yangqiu Song
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Knowledge is how understanding accumulates across people and generations: durable records that outlive their producers and that others can check, combine, teach, and correct. AI agents are now built and run by many independent users and organizations, and each agent is upgraded, replaced, or retired within months. Yet what an agent learns stays trapped in model parameters, a transient context window, or a system-specific memory store that is appended to and retrieved from rather than processed. We argue that the next generation of AI should be knowledge-centric, built around an explicit, continuously evolving knowledge layer independent of any single agent. In this loop, agents discover knowledge from their environments and trajectories; the layer internalizes it by turning fragmented, heterogeneous records and experience into composable, revisable understanding; and agents across systems and generations use the result and return new outcomes for revision. While discovery and use have advanced rapidly with large language model agents, internalization remains the bottleneck. We argue that internalization should become a persistent object of training and maintenance-centered on condition-preserving conceptualization of events and deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning across noisy, heterogeneous representations (text, tables, graphs, rules, and programs). To power this layer, we call for knowledge foundation models that provide shared neural capacity for knowledge computation, and outline a research agenda showing how an explicit knowledge layer delivers reuse, cost efficiency, auditability, and continuity across agent generations.

From Natural Language to Exact Cover: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Zebra Puzzles
从自然语言到精确覆盖：一种用于斑马谜题的神经符号方法
Paulius Skaisgiris, Thomas Pammer, Veronika Semmelrock, Mykyta Ielanskyi, Maximilian Heisinger, Erich Kobler
cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation has substantially improved the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, including code generation, data analysis, and exam-style question answering. Despite these advances, purely neural LLMs continue to struggle with elementary logical reasoning problems and lack the determinism, soundness, and reliability characteristic of symbolic reasoning systems. Conversely, classical symbolic methods such as SAT solving and exact cover guarantee correctness and completeness, but require problems to be expressed in highly specialized formal encodings, limiting their applicability to natural language inputs. In this work, we present a synergistic neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by combining neural semantic parsing with deterministic exact cover reasoning. Given a Zebra-style logic puzzle in natural language, an LLM translates entities and constraints into structured tool calls that construct an exact cover instance. A symbolic solver then computes the solution and provides feedback to iteratively refine invalid, under- or overconstrained encodings, exploiting the uniqueness property of Zebra puzzles. We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation across multiple parameter scales, post-training paradigms, and LLM families. The results demonstrate that our hybrid approach consistently outperforms strong plain neural baselines, including CoT prompting, as well as recent neuro-symbolic methods.

Abstract
Autoregressive decoding of large language models (LLMs) on edge devices is dominated by memory-bound general matrix--vector multiplication (GeMV) operations. Processing-using-DRAM (PUD) is a promising computing paradigm that can alleviate this bottleneck by reducing processor--memory data transfers and enabling massively parallel computation within DRAM (e.g., across 65,536 columns). However, weight matrices in individual LLM layers (e.g., a QKV matrix in Llama3 8B with 6,144 rows) are typically too small to fully utilize parallelism in PUD. To address this challenge, we propose an algorithm--system co-design for PUD-based LLM inference. At the algorithm level, we enable a subsequent projection to be packed with the current projection by reformulating it as a computation on the current residual state plus a correction for the residual update. Layer redundancy allows this correction to be approximated using fewer bit-serial steps. At the system level, we tailor data mapping and execution to improve utilization of either columns within DRAM subarrays (SIMD) or independently controlled banks (MIMD). Overall, we achieves up to $1.41\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup over the PUD baseline, corresponding to a $2.45\times$ speedup over processor-based execution.
Chinese Translation
边缘设备上大语言模型（LLM）的自回归解码主要由受内存限制的通用矩阵-向量乘法（GeMV）操作主导。使用DRAM进行处理（PUD）是一种有前景的计算范式，它可以通过减少处理器-内存数据传输并在DRAM内实现大规模并行计算（例如，跨65,536列）来缓解这一瓶颈。然而，单个LLM层中的权重矩阵（例如，Llama3 8B中具有6,144行的QKV矩阵）通常太小，无法充分利用PUD中的并行性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种面向基于PUD的LLM推理的算法-系统协同设计。在算法层面，我们通过将后续投影重新表述为对当前残差状态的计算加上对残差更新的校正，使后续投影能够与当前投影打包在一起。层冗余允许使用更少的位串行步骤来近似该校正。在系统层面，我们定制数据映射和执行，以提高DRAM子阵列内的列（SIMD）或独立控制的存储体（MIMD）的利用率。总体而言，与PUD基线相比，我们实现了高达$1.41\times$的端到端解码加速，这相当于相对于基于处理器的执行实现了$2.45\times$的加速。

Current state of LLMs for Arabic dialectal machine translation
用于阿拉伯方言机器翻译的大语言模型现状
Josef Jon, Rawan Bondok, Ondřej Bojar
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
This work presents an evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for English to dialectal Arabic machine translation on the MADAR dataset. We evaluate both translation directions (English to Arabic and vice-versa) on 16 Arabic dialects. Our experiments cover a diverse set of models, including specialized Arabic models (Jais, Nile), multilingual models (Gemma, Command-R, Mistral, Aya), and commercial APIs (GPT-4.1). We employ multiple evaluation metrics: BLEU, CHRF, COMET (both reference-based and reference-less variants) and GEMBA (LLM-as-a-judge), as well as a small-scale manual evaluation, to assess translation quality. We discuss the challenges of automatic MT evaluation, especially in the context of Arabic dialects. We also evaluate the ability of LLMs to classify the dialect used in a text. The study offers insights into the capabilities and limitations of current LLMs for dialectal Arabic machine translation, particularly highlighting the difficulty of handling dialectal diversity, although the results may be influenced by possible training data contamination, which is always a concern with LLMs.

Beyond Accuracy: How Quantization Affects Coding Agents
超越准确率：量化如何影响编程智能体
Areej Mehboob, Muhammad Ali Shafique, Muhammad Usman Qadeer, Hamza Farooq
cs.CL · cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Agents are increasingly used for coding tasks, but the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) limits where they can run. Quantization reduces model size, but its effects on coding agents that execute and revise programs remain underexplored. We compare BF16 with 4-bit AWQ and GPTQ for Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct (7B, 14B, and 32B) and Devstral-Small-2507 (24B) on OJBench coding problems across three seeds. We detect no statistically significant accuracy loss for any of the coding agents. However, final accuracy can conceal substantial behavioral changes: AWQ reduces Qwen-7B one-shot solves from 17 to 0 while increasing loop-based solves from 10 to 25. All Qwen-32B successes involve tool use, whereas Devstral rarely makes a valid executor call. Failure profiles also differ: Qwen-32B produces far more compilation errors than the smaller Qwen models, rising slightly under quantization, while Devstral's failures shift significantly from runtime errors toward wrong answers and timeouts. These findings indicate that quantization robustness in coding agents should be assessed through solution trajectories, tool use, and failure modes, in addition to final accuracy.

智能体越来越多地被用于编程任务，但大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理成本限制了它们可以运行的范围。量化减小了模型规模，但其对执行并修订程序的编程智能体的影响仍未得到充分探索。我们在三个随机种子下，针对 OJBench 编程问题，比较了 Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct（7B、14B 和 32B）与 Devstral-Small-2507（24B）的 BF16 与 4-bit AWQ 和 GPTQ。我们未检测到任何编程智能体在准确率上出现统计显著损失。然而，最终准确率可能掩盖显著的行为变化：AWQ 将 Qwen-7B 的单次求解从 17 降到 0，同时将基于循环的求解从 10 增加到 25。所有 Qwen-32B 的成功都涉及工具使用，而 Devstral 很少进行有效的执行器调用。失败概况也不同：Qwen-32B 产生的编译错误远多于较小的 Qwen 模型，且在量化下略有上升，而 Devstral 的失败则显著从运行时错误转向错误答案和超时。这些发现表明，除了最终准确率之外，还应通过求解轨迹、工具使用和失败模式来评估编程智能体的量化鲁棒性。

EviCast: Forecasting Retrieval Gains Through Shared Response Calibration
EviCast：通过共享响应校准预测检索增益
Yibo Wang, Jisheng Dang, Bimei Wang, Jiongpei Hou, Jingwen Zhao, Wenjun Ma, Fei Shen, Juncheng Li, Meng Wang, Qi Tian, Bin Hu, Tat-Seng Chua
cs.CL · cs.LG
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) extends large language models with external evidence, yet relevant evidence does not ensure that a generator can use it. Indiscriminate retrieval can degrade task performance while adding retrieval and long-context inference costs. Existing methods neither determine before large-scale execution whether a generator, task distribution, and retriever configuration is worth deploying nor diagnose multiple candidate retrievers under a shared budget. We introduce EviCast, a framework that forecasts retrieval value through interventional evidence-state decomposition. EviCast measures a generator's response to controlled evidence states once and combines this shared profile with the offline evidence-state distribution of each candidate retriever, yielding the end-to-end net utility and its 95% lower confidence bound without executing every RAG configuration. A state-refinement analysis characterizes when its binary and topology-aware instantiations are exact and when shared calibration is statistically more efficient than per-retriever calibration. In frozen evaluations, EviCast correctly decides all 14 HotpotQA retrieval configurations with a forecast error of 2.75 F1 points while reducing diagnostic generation calls by 80%, and it attains the lowest forecast error among seven predictors in the low-budget regime. Its topology-aware instantiation, EviCast-T, captures the complementarity between terminal and bridge evidence, correctly deciding all 16 configurations on MuSiQue and HotpotQA and 23 of 24 after prospective transfer to a third dataset. These results show that retrieval deployment depends on both evidence availability and the generator's ability to convert evidence structure into stable net utility. Code is available at https://github.com/YiboWang2002/EviCast.

检索增强生成（RAG）通过外部证据扩展大语言模型，然而相关证据并不保证生成器能够使用它。不加区分的检索可能降低任务性能，同时增加检索和长上下文推理成本。现有方法既不能在大规模执行之前判定某个生成器、任务分布和检索器配置是否值得部署，也不能在共享预算下诊断多个候选检索器。我们提出 EviCast，一个通过干预式证据状态分解来预测检索价值的框架。EviCast 一次性测量生成器对受控证据状态的响应，并将这一共享响应画像与每个候选检索器的离线证据状态分布相结合，从而在不执行每一种 RAG 配置的情况下得到端到端净效用及其 95% 置信下界。一项状态细化分析刻画了其二元实例化和拓扑感知实例化在何时是精确的，以及共享校准在何时在统计上比逐检索器校准更高效。在冻结评估中，EviCast 以 2.75 个 F1 点的预测误差正确判定全部 14 个 HotpotQA 检索配置，同时将诊断性生成调用减少 80%，并且在低预算情形下取得了七种预测器中最低的预测误差。其拓扑感知实例化 EviCast-T 捕捉终端证据与桥接证据之间的互补性，在 MuSiQue 和 HotpotQA 上正确判定全部 16 个配置，并在前瞻性迁移到第三个数据集后正确判定 24 个中的 23 个。这些结果表明，检索部署既取决于证据可用性，也取决于生成器将证据结构转化为稳定净效用的能力。代码可在 https://github.com/YiboWang2002/EviCast 获取。

Solver-Like Behavior in Large Language Models as Formalizers
大型语言模型作为形式化器时的类求解器行为
Rikhil Amonkar, Stuti Mohan, Kevin Nguyen, Ceyhun Efe Kayan, Ronan Le Bras, Li Zhang
cs.CL · cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
In the LLM-as-formalizer paradigm, a large language model translates a problem into a formal program and leaves the search to a solver, gaining the solver's guarantees. Formalizers are now often reasoning models that write a long reasoning trace before the program, yet they are judged only by the program's output. We find that the trace routinely does the solver's job, assigning, testing and ruling out values until it often reaches the full answer; we call this solver-like behavior (SLB). We define an ontology of SLB over the trace, the program and its output, and use LLM judges, checked against human labels, to label 2,000 generations from three reasoning models on four constraint satisfaction datasets, each formalized in a declarative and an imperative formal language. SLB appears in 85% of traces and takes 24% of reasoning tokens, yet the program usually recomputes the answer, so the effort is redundant. The 9% of programs that inherit the trace's answer also inherit its errors, and pass output-based evaluation whenever that answer is correct. The amount of SLB is not associated with accuracy, and SLB is more common in imperative Python than in declarative Z3 or PDDL. Cautionary prompts reduce it by only a quarter, but hiding the problem's values behind placeholders, which the program receives only at run time, removes 97% of it without loss of accuracy. Formalizers should therefore be evaluated by how their programs are reached, not only by what they output.
Chinese Translation
在 LLM 作为形式化器的范式中，大型语言模型将问题转换为形式化程序，并将搜索留给求解器，从而获得求解器的保证。如今，形式化器通常是推理模型，它们会在编写程序之前写出一段很长的推理轨迹，然而它们却仅根据程序的输出进行评判。我们发现，推理轨迹经常承担求解器的工作，进行取值分配、检验和排除，直到它常常得出完整答案；我们将这种行为称为类求解器行为（SLB）。我们围绕推理轨迹、程序及其输出定义了 SLB 的本体，并使用经过人工标签核对的 LLM 评判器，对三个推理模型在四个约束满足数据集上生成的 2,000 个样本进行标注，每个数据集分别用一种声明式和一种命令式形式语言进行形式化。SLB 出现在 85% 的推理轨迹中，并占用了 24% 的推理 token，但程序通常会重新计算答案，因此这部分工作是冗余的。继承推理轨迹答案的那 9% 程序也继承了它的错误，并且只要该答案正确，它们就能通过基于输出的评估。SLB 的多少与准确率不相关，并且 SLB 在命令式 Python 中比在声明式 Z3 或 PDDL 中更常见。警示性提示只能将其减少四分之一，而将问题的取值隐藏在占位符之后（程序只在运行时才接收这些取值），可消除其中 97% 的 SLB，且不会损失准确率。因此，对形式化器的评估应考察其程序是如何得出的，而不仅仅是考察其输出什么。

Same Sentence, Different Construct: Identity-Swapped Rationales Reveal Measurement Non-Invariance in LLM Hate Speech Classifiers
同一句话，不同构念：身份对调后的理由揭示大语言模型仇恨言论分类器中的测量非不变性
Wenchang Wang, Yue Song
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models are increasingly used as measurement instruments for socially consequential constructs such as hate speech, and are typically validated by their aggregate agreement with human labels. A valid instrument must also apply the same construct to every group it measures. We test this requirement using 421 \hc{} templates that are instantiated identically for seven protected groups, so that only the identity term varies. Four LLM classifiers each exceed 0.95 balanced accuracy, yet within identical templates two of them miss hateful statements about women at markedly higher rates than the same statements about other groups (excess false-negative rates of 8.3 and 4.4 percentage points), a gap first reported for fine-tuned classifiers in 2021. We show how the construct shifts. Comparing rationales within each template, we find that models invoke protected-group status for other groups but recast the identical statement about women as personal dislike or as aimed at an individual, in 22 of 30 missed templates for one model. Adding the benchmark's own definition, which lists sex as a protected characteristic, does not close the gap, and the contrast persists. Apparent false-positive disparities, by contrast, largely vanish under identity control and trace to reclaimed slurs present only for some groups. Errors shared by all models concentrate where model and benchmark definitions diverge, and pairwise counterfactual accuracy adds little beyond endpoint accuracy. We argue that validating LLM measurement requires identity-controlled tests of measurement invariance that examine both decisions and the criteria models state for them.

大语言模型正越来越多地被用作针对具有社会后果的构念（如仇恨言论）的测量工具，并且通常通过其与人工标签的总体一致性来加以验证。有效的测量工具还必须对其所测量的每一个群体应用相同的构念。我们使用 421 个 \hc{} 模板来检验这一要求，这些模板对七个受保护群体以完全相同的方式实例化，因此只有身份词发生变化。四个 LLM 分类器各自都超过 0.95 的平衡准确率，然而在相同模板内，其中两个分类器漏掉关于女性的仇恨性陈述的比率显著高于关于其他群体的相同陈述（假阴性率分别高出 8.3 和 4.4 个百分点），这一差距最早于 2021 年针对微调分类器被报告。我们展示了该构念如何发生偏移。通过比较每个模板内的理由，我们发现，模型会对其他群体援引受保护群体身份，但会把关于女性的相同陈述改写为个人厌恶或针对个人的表达；对其中一个模型而言，这在 30 个被漏判的模板中有 22 个如此。加入基准自身的定义（其中将性别列为受保护特征）并不能弥合这一差距，而且这种对比仍然存在。相比之下，表观假阳性差异在身份控制下基本消失，并可追溯到仅在某些群体中出现的被重新夺用的侮辱语。所有模型共有的错误集中在模型定义与基准定义发生分歧之处，而配对反事实准确率在端点准确率之外几乎没有额外贡献。我们认为，验证 LLM 测量需要受身份控制的测量不变性检验，这些检验既要考察决策，也要考察模型为这些决策所陈述的标准。

From Language to Country to Valence: A Multilingual Audit of Stereotype Bias Across LLMs
从语言到国家到效价：跨LLMs的刻板印象偏见的多语言审计
Zihao Sun
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for education, recruitment, workplace decision support, and other consequential applications, making pre-deployment social-bias detection essential. Yet major benchmarks are English-centred or translated, focus mainly on negative stereotypes, and may miss linguistic and cultural variation. We investigate gender, racial, and religious bias using 12,000 locally written Reddit posts in English, Spanish, French, and German. Only search terms are translated, preserving local context. The dataset is balanced by language and category; English gender is additionally balanced by stereotype valence. Three open-weight and three proprietary API-based models are evaluated with a two-blank design that reduces grammatical-gender cues. Religion has the highest absolute choice imbalance in every model-language condition. Spanish is highest for gender, whereas German is highest for race and religion. The evaluated API models score below the open-weight models throughout. Negative English-gender items exceed positive items; Australian and Mexican contexts exceed their Canadian and Spanish counterparts. These descriptive differences measure choice concentration, not stereotype endorsement or causal country effects. The crossed patterns show how aggregate scores can conceal category- and context-specific behaviour, motivating closer inspection before deployment.

cs.CL / 32 / 2611.02587
They Know Where It Is, But Not What It Says: A Bilingual Hallucination Benchmark of Hadith Recall in Open LLMs
它们知道它在哪里，却不知道它说了什么：开放大语言模型中圣训回忆的双语幻觉基准
Dayam Nadeem, Safdar Mustafa, Ameen Ur Rehman, Shahab Saquib Sohail, Mohammad Nadeem, Usman Naseem
cs.CL · cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models are increasingly consulted for religious knowledge, including the recall of specific Hadith (recorded sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Unlike open-ended generation, Hadith recall is a high-stakes, verifiable task: a reference (collection, chapter, and Hadith number) has exactly one correct text, and any deviation from it constitutes a fabrication that can be mistaken for authentic scripture. This study introduces a bilingual (English/Arabic) benchmark that probes five open-weight, locally-deployable language models (Mistral-7B, Gemma3-4B, Jais-7B, ALLaM-7B, and Phi4-mini-3.8B) across all six canonical Sunni Hadith collections (Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Da'ud, Jami' al-Tirmidhi, Sunan an-Nasa'i, Sunan Ibn Majah), sampling 500 Hadith per collection (3,000 per model per language, 30,000 responses total). Each model is given only the bibliographic reference and asked to reproduce the exact Hadith text, with no retrieval augmentation, and is scored on lexical fidelity (BLEU) and semantic fidelity (multilingual cosine similarity), with refusals flagged separately. Across all five models and both languages, 0% of 30,000 responses achieve both high lexical and high semantic fidelity, i.e., an exact, verifiable match to the source text. Arabic responses fare uniformly worse than English. These findings suggest that current open-weight LLMs, used without retrieval grounding, are unreliable and potentially dangerous sources for exact religious-text recall, and that deployment for Islamic scholarship should mandate retrieval-augmented generation over a verified corpus rather than parametric memory. The complete code, prompts, evaluation pipeline, and scored outputs are publicly available at https://github.com/dayam8696/Hadith-Hallucination-Benchmark.

大语言模型越来越多地被用于查询宗教知识，包括对特定圣训（先知穆罕默德——愿主福安之——被记录的言行）的回忆。与开放式生成不同，圣训回忆是一项高风险、可验证的任务：一个参考文献（所属集、章和圣训编号）只对应唯一正确的文本，任何偏离都构成伪造，而伪造可能被误认为真正的经文。本研究引入一个双语（英语/阿拉伯语）基准，在全部六部权威逊尼派圣训集（《布哈里圣训实录》《穆斯林圣训实录》《阿布·达乌德圣训集》《提尔密济圣训集》《奈萨仪圣训集》《伊本·马哲圣训集》）上考察五个开放权重、可本地部署的语言模型（Mistral-7B、Gemma3-4B、Jais-7B、ALLaM-7B 和 Phi4-mini-3.8B），每部圣训集抽取 500 条圣训（每个模型每种语言 3,000 条，总计 30,000 条回答）。每个模型只获得书目式参考文献，并被要求复现准确的圣训文本，不进行检索增强，并按词汇保真度（BLEU）和语义保真度（多语言余弦相似度）评分，拒绝回答的情况单独标记。在所有五个模型和两种语言中，30,000 条回答中有 0% 同时达到高词汇保真度和高语义保真度，即与源文本完全一致、可验证的匹配。阿拉伯语回答的表现普遍差于英语。这些发现表明，当前开放权重的大语言模型在不使用检索依据的情况下，作为精确回忆宗教文本的来源是不可靠的，且可能具有危险性；将其用于伊斯兰学术研究时，应当强制要求在经过验证的语料库上使用检索增强生成，而不是参数化记忆。完整代码、提示词、评估流程和评分输出已公开于 https://github.com/dayam8696/Hadith-Hallucination-Benchmark。

LLMs Cannot Be Neutral: Gender Sensitivity Across Candidates, Evaluators, and Models
大语言模型无法保持中立：跨候选人、评估者与模型的性别敏感性
Danial Amin, Joni Salminen, Bernard J. Jansen
cs.CL · cs.HC
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate candidates for professional roles, raising concerns about their sensitivity to demographic identities. We examine how candidate and evaluator gender assignments affect decisions by LLM-as-a-Judge (LaJ) models and decision language models (DLMs). In a hypothetical city council voting task, eight models evaluated 240 synthetic professional narratives from NVIDIA's US and French Nemotron-Personas datasets under independently varied gender assignments, producing 30,720 judgments. Explicit candidate gender labels increased Yes-vote probability by 1.05-1.73 percentage points relative to unspecified gender, while only the nonbinary evaluator assignment showed a significant increase (1.26 points). Identity matching showed no significant overall association. Yes-vote rates varied across models (81.3-97.2%), and 2.5-3.3% of decisions reversed relative to the unspecified-identity baseline. Under direct substitutions between explicit gender identities, DLMs exhibited fewer decision reversals than LaJ models (1.18% vs. 3.38%), indicating lower observed decision-level gender sensitivity among the tested DLMs. These findings demonstrate that gender sensitivity depends on candidate and evaluator identities and the evaluation model, while highlighting the importance of examining individual decision consistency alongside aggregate differences.

PGuard: A Native, Streaming, and Plug-in Guardrail for Multimodal Large Language Models
PGuard：一种用于多模态大语言模型的原生、流式且插件式护栏
Junyu Lin, Mengjie Wu, Yonghao Dong, Yuchuan Fu, Jinfeng Li, Xiaodan Li, Xiaohan Yuan, Yicheng Liu, Yuefeng Chen, Hui Xue, Jingyi Wang, Yitong Yang, Jiyuan Fu, Qinga He
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
As streaming generation becomes the dominant serving paradigm for both text-only and multimodal large language models, ensuring safety throughout the generation process has become a critical challenge. We introduce PGuard, a native, streaming, and plug-in guardrail that transforms safety monitoring from an external serving dependency into an integrated capability of the backbone model. PGuard directly leverages the backbone's intermediate representations for token-level safety detection, without altering its original inference pathway or generation behavior. Specifically, dynamic layer gating selectively aggregates residual-stream representations across layers to extract safety-relevant signals during both prefill and autoregressive decoding. To balance detection accuracy and computational efficiency, PGuard supports multiple representation-modeling architectures, including a lightweight stateless variant and sequence-aware variants built on multi-scale causal EMA-attention and GRU-based recurrent modules. Its design also accounts for the execution characteristics of LLM serving frameworks, such as SGLang, optimizing computation and data access to minimize additional runtime and synchronization overhead. As a result, PGuard incurs only 0.82-2.26% end-to-end overhead on the hundred-billion-parameter backbone Qwen3.5-122B-A10B served by SGLang. Extensive evaluations across more than 30 benchmarks spanning text and multimodal safety, jailbreaks, cyber and CBRN risks, multilingual scenarios, and real-world traffic demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among native guardrails. On text queries with Qwen3.5-9B, PGuard achieves an average F1 score of 0.836, approaching dedicated external guardrails, while supporting deployment-time configuration of category-specific thresholds and enforcement actions.

Tug of Watts: A study on the Energy - Accuracy Trade-off of Large Language Models on Medical Question Answering Tasks
瓦特之争：大型语言模型在医学问答任务中的能耗-准确率权衡研究
Viju Sudhi, Giulio Billi, Andreea Scrob, Regina Stodden, Philipp Cimiano
cs.CL · cs.AI
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in medical question answering (QA) systems. While recent works aim at incrementally improving the downstream task accuracy, an empirical estimation of the models' energy consumption and the associated carbon footprints is often overlooked. In this study, we demonstrate how practitioners can estimate energy consumption and arrive at reliable emission estimates for medical QA tasks available in the OpenMedical-LLM leaderboard by investigating 13 LLMs from 3 model families ranging from 270M to 14B parameters. We discuss how one can critically interpret energy versus accuracy trade-offs for a set of models for a given task. With this work, we underline that reporting disjoint energy and accuracy metrics alone does not suffice for careful trade-off assessments, but it also demands systematic construction and interpretation of joint trade-off metrics. We envisage such studies aiding practitioners in adopting better and more efficient models for their task and helping them become active participants in building sustainable LLM pipelines.

PlagiaCorpus: A Bilingual, Adversarial, and Cross-Lingual Dataset for Forensic Plagiarism Detection
PlagiaCorpus：一个用于取证抄袭检测的双语、对抗性与跨语言数据集
Adel Ammar, Serry Sibaee, Wadii Boulila
cs.CL · cs.AI · cs.CY · cs.DL · cs.IR
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
PlagiaCorpus is a bilingual Arabic-English dataset for benchmarking plagiarism and text-reuse detection, including reuse produced by large language models (LLMs) and reuse across languages. It contains 198,643 text records: a source corpus of 34,885 passages drawn from English and Arabic Wikipedia and two openly licensed book collections, and 163,758 queries (147,381 for training and 16,377 for testing). The queries cover five reuse classes of increasing difficulty, namely verbatim copying, character-level obfuscation, same-language paraphrasing by two different LLMs, and English--Arabic translation with structural paraphrasing, together with a Safe class of non-reused passages. Every positive query is linked to its source passage, and the train/test split is grouped by source passage so that no passage contributes queries to both splits. The release was curated through language identification, removal of LLM generation artefacts, and exact and cross-lingual de-duplication. Technical validation reports per-class length statistics, automatic checks of the train/test split, and inter-annotator agreement on a manually rated sample. The dataset is distributed in JSON and Parquet formats under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license.

An Experimental Study of Hybrid Retrieval, NLI and Open-source LLMs for Scientific Claim Verification
用于科学主张验证的混合检索、NLI 与开源 LLM 的实验研究
Lakshmi Narayanan P, Narenkarthik K, Naren Kumar C
cs.CL · cs.AI · cs.LG
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Claim verification is the task of deciding whether a source text supports a claim, contradicts it, or lacks sufficient evidence. Natural Language Inference (NLI) models can judge whether a single sentence supports or contradicts a claim, but they struggle when the evidence is spread across several sentences. Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) can reason across sentences, but may draw conclusions the text does not support. In this experimental study, we test whether a conservative fusion rule, labeling a claim Support or Contradict only when both models agree and defaulting to Not Enough Evidence otherwise, combines their strengths. We construct a benchmark of 2,035 claims from SciFact and CliniFact (858 Support, 152 Contradict, 1,025 Not Enough Evidence). We retrieve the top five most relevant sentences per claim using a hybrid of semantic and lexical (BM25) retrieval, which slightly outperforms either method alone. These retrieved sentences are then provided to every verification model. We then compare a DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli NLI baseline against Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen3 8B, and Mistral 7B. Qwen3 achieves the highest Macro-F1 (0.7937), followed by Llama 3.1 (0.7204) and Mistral (0.6388), while the NLI baseline reaches only 0.3157. Contrary to our hypothesis, fusion degrades performance, dropping Macro-F1 to 0.7392, 0.6730, and 0.5991, respectively. To understand this decline, we analyze agreements, disagreements, and common error patterns between the NLI and LLM verifiers. Our error analysis shows that NLI and LLM disagreements often result in correct LLM predictions being overturned.

DepthGraft: Structural Regularization through Hierarchical Cross-Layer KV Reconstruction
DepthGraft：通过分层跨层 KV 重建实现结构正则化
Xiaohan Qin, Xiangdong Zhang, Yu Wang, Huaijin Wu, Zhuo Xia, Yebin Yang, Junchi Yan
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
Scaling depth is a key route to stronger large language models, but Pre-LN architectures often suffer from depth-wise information dilution, limiting the effective use of deep layers. While cross-layer connectivity has proven effective at mitigating this problem, existing designs usually introduce additional computation or memory access. We revisit cross-layer KV sharing as an efficient form of such connectivity. Beyond cache compression, each KV reuse edge creates a direct gradient path from deep layers to source KV projections, turning KV sharing into an implicit structural regularizer for KV representation geometry. We provide a systematic analysis of this mechanism, showing that proper sharing topologies sharpen key retrieval directions while enriching the value content subspace, whereas existing adjacent or global-anchor designs do not fully exploit this effect. Motivated by this, we propose DepthGraft, a hierarchical KV-sharing architecture that reconstructs deep-layer KV from stride-aligned shallow-middle source pairs. DepthGraft distributes non-local gradient flow across source layers, while preserving prefill early completion and reducing KV cache by roughly one third. Experiments on dense and MoE models from 0.5B to 16B parameters show consistent downstream improvements under both GQA and MLA. Notably, on the 16B MoE model, DepthGraft achieves a 7.0% absolute improvement on MMLU-Pro, along with gains of 6.6% on CMMLU and 6.4% on C3. These results validate the potential of DepthGraft as a scalable design for large-scale pretraining. The project page is available at https://github.com/jianke0604/DepthGraft.

扩展深度是获得更强大型语言模型的一条关键路径，但 Pre-LN 架构常常遭受沿深度方向的信息稀释，限制了深层网络的有效利用。尽管跨层连接已被证明能有效缓解这一问题，但现有设计通常会引入额外的计算或内存访问。我们重新审视跨层 KV 共享，将其视为此类连接的一种高效形式。除了缓存压缩之外，每条 KV 复用边都会从深层到源 KV 投影创建一条直接梯度路径，从而将 KV 共享转化为针对 KV 表示几何的隐式结构正则化器。我们对该机制进行了系统分析，表明恰当的共享拓扑会锐化键的检索方向，同时丰富值的内容子空间，而现有的相邻或全局锚点设计并未充分利用这一效应。受此启发，我们提出 DepthGraft，一种分层 KV 共享架构，它从步幅对齐的浅层-中层源对中重建深层 KV。DepthGraft 将非局部梯度流分布到各源层，同时保持预填充的提前完成，并将 KV 缓存减少约三分之一。在 0.5B 到 16B 参数的稠密模型和 MoE 模型上进行的实验表明，在 GQA 和 MLA 下均取得了一致的下游性能提升。值得注意的是，在 16B MoE 模型上，DepthGraft 在 MMLU-Pro 上实现了 7.0% 的绝对提升，同时在 CMMLU 上获得 6.6% 的提升，在 C3 上获得 6.4% 的提升。这些结果验证了 DepthGraft 作为大规模预训练可扩展设计的潜力。项目页面见 https://github.com/jianke0604/DepthGraft。

cs.CL / 39 / 2611.03280
Specificity Bias and the Wikipedia Paradox: An xAI Analysis of AI Text Detectors under Domain Shift
特异性偏差与维基百科悖论：对域偏移下AI文本检测器的xAI分析
Nico Morloher, Johannes Reschke, Mohamed Mady
cs.CL
large language model
大语言模型相关
Abstract
The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) demands reliable detection of human-authored versus synthetic text. However, current Transformer-based detectors often experience severe performance degradation during domain shifts and operate as opaque classifiers. This paper investigates the robustness and interpretability of fine-tuned Transformer models (DistilBERT, RoBERTa) by evaluating them against a custom out-of-distribution (OOD) dataset of hyper-local news synthesized via open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma). To analyze model decision boundaries, we apply a tripartite Explainable AI (xAI) framework using SHAP. Our analysis reveals three key phenomena: First, detectors often rely on a "Call-to-Action" syndrome inherent to instruction-tuned LLMs rather than generic machine text. Second, we observe a "Specificity Bias," where LLMs successfully bypass detection by hallucinating specific named entities and mimicking conversational imperfection. Finally, we illustrate the "Wikipedia Paradox," wherein formal, objective human writing is frequently misclassified as AI due to its low statistical burstiness. These findings demonstrate that purely statistical detection paradigms face systematic limitations in highly structured human domains, emphasizing the critical need for semantically-aware, interpretable detection architectures.
